items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I met him when he was playing at Ryan's. With Art Hodes.

ctx.x: I don't remember all the places either anymore.

Well, there was George's Tavern in the village where Frankie Newton used to play and Al Casey, guitar player, played there. The village vanguard used to have nice groups like Art Hodes had a trio there with Max Kaminsky and Freddie Moore.
I remember, I think, Albert Nicholas and Zutti and others were there. Yeah. Lead Belly quite a while.
